## Où j'en suis
PostgreSQL 17 upgrade of the analytics RDS on branch noa/rds-pg17, open draft PR #57. On Nov 17, pg_partman was upgraded 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 on staging and maintenance ran clean; after fixing the blue/green blocker (rds.logical_replication = 1 + reboot), the staging apply succeeded and analytics-staging has run PG 17.2 since 14:20 UTC, with dbt all green (14/14 models, time within noise of 16.4). The runbook was updated with the logical_replication + reboot step for prod. (source: ses-pg-3, src-pr57, src-slack-infra, src-linear-kes298)

- [en-cours] Full week of staging on PG 17 before prod sign-off; watch for incidents on staging this week (source: ses-pg-3, src-linear-kes298, src-slack-infra)
- [prochaine-étape] After Maya's sign-off (earliest Nov 24), pick the prod window: prod needs its own reboot window for rds.logical_replication before the blue/green cutover, avoiding the dbt lock 01:00–03:30 UTC (source: ses-pg-3, ses-pg-1, src-linear-kes298)
- [essai-raté] terraform apply of the staging blue/green failed first: RDS requires rds.logical_replication = 1 in the source parameter group plus a reboot; fixed by adding it and rebooting (source: ses-pg-3)
- [essai-raté] terraform init -upgrade pulled AWS provider v6 (37 unrelated changes); provider pinned to 5.82 instead (source: ses-pg-1, src-pr57)
- [question] Prod cutover date and window, to be decided with Maya after the staging week (source: ses-pg-3, src-linear-kes298)
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off; apply_immediately stays false; avoid the dbt lock window (source: ses-pg-1)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to ~> 5.82.0, no v6 in this PR (source: ses-pg-1, src-pr57)
